mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS batch_estate_market_reports ( report_id VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, lawd_cd VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, deal_ymd VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, collected_at VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, item_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, avg_deal_amount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, max_deal_amount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, min_deal_amount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houseinfos ( apt_seq VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '아파트코드', sgg_cd VARCHAR(5) NULL COMMENT '시군구코드', umd_cd VARCHAR(5) NULL COMMENT '읍면동코드', umd_nm VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT '읍면동이름', jibun VARCHAR(10) NULL COMMENT '지번', road_nm_sgg_cd VARCHAR(5) NULL COMMENT '도로명시군구코드', road_nm VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT '도로명', road_nm_bonbun VARCHAR(10) NULL COMMENT '도로명기초번호', road_nm_bubun VARCHAR(10) NULL COMMENT '도로명추가번호', apt_nm VARCHAR(40) NULL COMMENT '아파트이름', build_year INT NULL COMMENT '준공년도', latitude VARCHAR(45) NULL COMMENT '위도', longitude VARCHAR(45) NULL COMMENT '경도', PRIMARY KEY (apt_seq) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS housedeals ( no INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '거래번호', apt_seq VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT '아파트코드', apt_dong VARCHAR(40) NULL COMMENT '아파트동', floor VARCHAR(3) NULL COMMENT '아파트층', deal_year INT NULL COMMENT '거래년도', deal_month INT NULL COMMENT '거래월', deal_day INT NULL COMMENT '거래일', exclu_use_ar DECIMAL(7, 2) NULL COMMENT '아파트면적', deal_amount VARCHAR(10) NULL COMMENT '거래가격', PRIMARY KEY (no), INDEX idx_housedeals_apt_seq (apt_seq),
INDEX idx_housedeals_apt_date (apt_seq, deal_year, deal_month), CONSTRAINT fk_housedeals_houseinfos FOREIGN KEY (apt_seq) REFERENCES houseinfos (apt_seq) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
ALTER TABLE batch_estate_market_reports MODIFY deal_ymd VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS batch_estate_market_items ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, report_id VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, source_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, lawd_cd VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, deal_ymd VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, apt_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, dong VARCHAR(100), jibun VARCHAR(100), deal_amount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, area DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, floor INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, build_year INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deal_date VARCHAR(10), raw_address VARCHAR(500), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_batch_estate_report_id (report_id), INDEX idx_batch_estate_lawd_deal (lawd_cd, deal_ymd) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_estate_market_reports (report_id, title, lawd_cd, deal_ymd, collected_at, item_count, avg_deal_amount, max_deal_amount, min_deal_amount) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{title}, #{lawdCd}, #{dealYmd}, #{collectedAt}, #{itemCount}, #{avgDealAmount}, #{maxDealAmount}, #{minDealAmount})

INSERT INTO batch_estate_market_items (report_id, source_type, lawd_cd, deal_ymd, apt_name, dong, jibun, deal_amount, area, floor, build_year, deal_date, raw_address) VALUES
(#{item.reportId}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.lawdCd}, #{item.dealYmd}, #{item.aptName}, #{item.dong}, #{item.jibun}, #{item.dealAmount}, #{item.area}, #{item.floor}, #{item.buildYear}, #{item.dealDate}, #{item.rawAddress})
mapper.select: SELECT report_id, title, lawd_cd, deal_ymd, collected_at, item_count, avg_deal_amount, max_deal_amount, min_deal_amount FROM batch_estate_market_reports WHERE report_id = #{reportId}

SELECT report_id, source_type, lawd_cd, deal_ymd, apt_name, dong, jibun, deal_amount, area, floor, build_year, deal_date, raw_address FROM batch_estate_market_items WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO houseinfos (apt_seq, sgg_cd, umd_cd, umd_nm, jibun, road_nm_sgg_cd, road_nm, road_nm_bonbun, road_nm_bubun, apt_nm, build_year, latitude, longitude) VALUES
( CONCAT('BT', #{item.lawdCd}, '-', SUBSTRING(MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', #{item.lawdCd}, #{item.dong}, #{item.jibun}, #{item.aptName})), 1, 10)), #{item.lawdCd}, COALESCE(( SELECT SUBSTRING(dc.dong_code, 6, 5) FROM dongcodes dc WHERE dc.dong_code LIKE CONCAT(#{item.lawdCd}, '%') AND dc.dong_name = #{item.dong} LIMIT 1 ), '00000'), #{item.dong}, #{item.jibun}, #{item.lawdCd}, '', '', '', #{item.aptName}, #{item.buildYear}, NULL, NULL )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE apt_nm = VALUES(apt_nm), build_year = VALUES(build_year), umd_nm = VALUES(umd_nm), jibun = VALUES(jibun), umd_cd = VALUES(umd_cd)
mapper.update: UPDATE houseinfos hi JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT('BT', item.lawd_cd, '-', SUBSTRING(MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', item.lawd_cd, item.dong, item.jibun, item.apt_name )), 1, 10)) AS apt_seq FROM batch_estate_market_items item WHERE item.report_id = #{reportId} ) report_item ON report_item.apt_seq = hi.apt_seq JOIN dongcodes dc ON dc.dong_code LIKE CONCAT(hi.sgg_cd, '%') AND REPLACE(dc.dong_name, ' ', '') = REPLACE(hi.umd_nm, ' ', '') SET hi.umd_cd = SUBSTRING(dc.dong_code, 6, 5) WHERE hi.umd_cd IS NULL OR hi.umd_cd = '' OR hi.umd_cd = '00000'
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT hi.apt_seq AS aptSeq, TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', dc.sido_name, dc.gugun_name, hi.umd_nm, hi.jibun)) AS address FROM batch_estate_market_items item JOIN houseinfos hi ON hi.apt_seq = CONCAT('BT', item.lawd_cd, '-', SUBSTRING(MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', item.lawd_cd, item.dong, item.jibun, item.apt_name )), 1, 10)) /* 좌표 보강 주소에는 시·군·구명만 필요하다. 법정동 코드가 아직 00000인 행도 주소 검색 대상에서 빠지지 않도록, 시군구 대표 행(예: 1111000000)을 조인한다. */ JOIN dongcodes dc ON dc.dong_code = CONCAT(hi.sgg_cd, '00000') WHERE item.report_id = #{reportId} AND (hi.latitude IS NULL OR hi.latitude = '' OR hi.longitude IS NULL OR hi.longitude = '') AND hi.jibun IS NOT NULL AND hi.jibun != ''
AND dc.gugun_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY hi.apt_seq
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING(dong_code, 1, 5) AS lawd_cd FROM dongcodes WHERE dong_code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(dong_code) >= 5 ORDER BY lawd_cd
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING(dong_code, 1, 5) AS lawd_cd FROM dongcodes WHERE sido_name = #{sidoName} AND gugun_name IS NOT NULL AND dong_code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(dong_code) >= 5 ORDER BY lawd_cd
